snippet.title: Poker Rivals by Playfish
snippet.description:
Play now on http://apps.facebook.com/pokerrivals

Whether you're a newcomer to Hold 'Em or you're an old hand, you'll feel instantly at home in the ultimate poker experience. Hit the tables with your friends or try your hand in a tournament, then show everyone you've got the right stuff by buying new clothes, accessories, even a whole new apartment with your winnings. You can even buy your own private yacht, but that's for the real high rollers only.

Veterans can hit the tables right away while beginners can choose to clue up in the Poker Rivals tutorial -- don't worry if you've never played a hand of poker, it'll teach you everything you need to know. Have you got what it takes for Poker Rivals?
